data: What is the ERA metric value of the blue line with square markers for s=4 in the right graph?

The question asks for the ERA metric value of the blue line with square markers for s=4 in the right graph. The right graph corresponds to BERT / ERA, and the blue line represents T=1. The blue line with square markers intersects the y-axis at approximately 0.2 when s=4. Therefore, the ERA metric value is around 0.2.
